source_state: uncommitted bounded inference implementation with common Metal workspace facts and exact I32 causal coordinates

native_runtime.patches: safemlx-sys/src/mlx-c/patches at the recorded source revision

command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -p eredu-backend-mlx --lib --features metal,accelerate backend::nn::workspace -- --include-ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
measurement: MLX active peak minus evaluated input residency, reset before each equation and read after output completion. Original input handles stay live. Exclusive serial test runner with Metal access. Allocator cache retained between cases to exercise oversized reuse.
inputs: Nonzero transposed inputs; FP32, FP16, BF16 and mixed FP16/BF16 and BF16/FP32 pairs; shapes [1,1], [7,13], [65,257]. Same generic portable equation executed by metadata and native backends.
bound_derivation: Vendored GPU copy and Metal unary/binary/ternary implementations: output plus each possible input cast, allowing up to four bytes per element.
Backend SiLU/sigmoid custom kernels: input widening, row-contiguous copy, output and final conversion. Composed activation/gating equations count every operation and scalar.
Range slices retain input roots; native static integer selection can reshape-copy a strided slice, charged separately.
Concatenation charges output and each possible input cast; reshape permits allocation or input aliasing.
Causal masks charge exact I32 coordinate arrays, optional window subtraction/scalar and all boolean intermediates.
Each buffer includes host-page rounding and bounded oversized allocator-cache reuse. No fusion, donation or early temporary release is assumed.
limitations: These are operator bounds and checks, not complete model workspace quotes or production request-budget admission.
Active tensor-buffer capacity excludes allocator-cache residency, Metal heaps, driver/JIT storage and unrelated process memory.
Unpriced required operators and mixed signed/unsigned integer promotions wider than four bytes remain unknown.
